## Model: (pairwise log comparision) with spline time effect
```{r}
library(limma)
library(splines)
N <- nrow(L_sub)
K <- ncol(L_sub)
time_num <- c(
  d0 = 0, d0.25 = 0.25, d0.5 = 0.5,
  d1 = 1, d2 = 2, d3 = 3, d5 = 5
)[as.character(tp)]

stopifnot(!any(is.na(time_num)))

eps <- 1e-8
pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))
n_pairs <- nrow(pair_mat)

log_ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = n_pairs)

for (p in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
  k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
  k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
  log_ratio_mat[, p] <-
    log(L_sub[, k1] + eps) -
    log(L_sub[, k2] + eps)
}

colnames(log_ratio_mat) <-
  apply(pair_mat, 1, \(idx) paste0("T", idx[1], "_vs_T", idx[2]))

Y_lr <- t(log_ratio_mat)   # features × samples
```

```{r}
df_spline <- 3
design_s <- model.matrix(
  ~ 0 + tissue + tissue:ns(time_num, df = df_spline),
  data = samples_sub
)
colnames(design_s) <- make.names(colnames(design_s))

fit_s <- lmFit(Y_lr, design_s)
fit_s <- eBayes(fit_s)

# test all tissue-specific spline coefficients jointly
time_cols <- grep("^tissue.*ns\\.", colnames(design_s))
res_time_pairs <- topTable(fit_s, coef = time_cols, number = Inf, sort.by = "F")
fit_s$F.p.value 
```

```{r}
library(splines)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

plot_pair_spline_by_tissue_sep <- function(k1, k2,
                                          fit_s,
                                          samples_sub,
                                          df_spline = 3,
                                          t_min = 0, t_max = 5, n_grid = 200,
                                          palette = "Dark2",
                                          n_first = 6) {
  stopifnot(k1 != k2)

  # ---- find the row name for this pair in fit_s ----
  pair1 <- paste0("T", k1, "_vs_T", k2)
  pair2 <- paste0("T", k2, "_vs_T", k1)

  rn <- rownames(fit_s$coefficients)
  if (pair1 %in% rn) {
    pair_name <- pair1
    sign_mult <- 1
  } else if (pair2 %in% rn) {
    pair_name <- pair2
    sign_mult <- -1
  } else {
    stop("Cannot find this pair in fit_s rownames. Check your pair naming.")
  }

  # ---- prediction grid across all tissues ----
  tgrid <- seq(t_min, t_max, length.out = n_grid)
  tissues <- levels(samples_sub$tissue)

  newdat <- expand.grid(time_num = tgrid, tissue = tissues)
  newdat$tissue <- factor(newdat$tissue, levels = tissues)

  # IMPORTANT: same formula as fit (Option B)
  Xnew <- model.matrix(~ 0 + tissue + tissue:ns(time_num, df = df_spline),
                       data = newdat)
  colnames(Xnew) <- make.names(colnames(Xnew))

  # align columns with fit
  common_cols <- intersect(colnames(Xnew), colnames(fit_s$coefficients))
  Xnew2 <- Xnew[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
  B2    <- fit_s$coefficients[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]

  # ---- predict ----
  pred <- as.numeric(B2[pair_name, , drop = TRUE] %*% t(Xnew2))
  pred <- sign_mult * pred

  plot_df <- cbind(newdat, log_ratio = pred)

  # ---- split tissues into two sets (6 + 7) ----
  n_first <- min(n_first, length(tissues))
  tissues_1 <- tissues[seq_len(n_first)]
  tissues_2 <- tissues[(n_first + 1):length(tissues)]

  p1 <- ggplot(filter(plot_df, tissue %in% tissues_1),
               aes(x = time_num, y = log_ratio, color = tissue)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = palette) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("log(T", k1, "/T", k2, ") by tissue (1–", n_first, ")"),
      x = "Time (days)",
      y = bquote(log(theta[.(k1)]/theta[.(k2)])),
      color = "Tissue"
    )

  p2 <- ggplot(filter(plot_df, tissue %in% tissues_2),
               aes(x = time_num, y = log_ratio, color = tissue)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = palette) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("log(T", k1, "/T", k2, ") by tissue (", n_first + 1, "–", length(tissues), ")"),
      x = "Time (days)",
      y = bquote(log(theta[.(k1)]/theta[.(k2)])),
      color = "Tissue"
    )

  list(p1 = p1, p2 = p2, data = plot_df,
       tissues_1 = tissues_1, tissues_2 = tissues_2)
}

# example:
out <- plot_pair_spline_by_tissue_sep(
  k1 = 14, k2 = 7,
  fit_s = fit_s,
  samples_sub = samples_sub,
  df_spline = 3,
  n_first = 6
)

out$p1  # tissues 1–6
out$p2  # tissues 7–13

```

## Model: spline time effect without tissue (pairwise log comparision)
```{r}
design_noT <- model.matrix(~ ns(time_num, df = df_spline), data = samples_sub)
colnames(design_noT) <- make.names(colnames(design_noT))

fit_noT <- lmFit(Y_lr, design_noT)
fit_noT <- eBayes(fit_noT)

time_cols_noT <- grep("^ns\\.", colnames(design_noT))
res_time_pairs_noT <- topTable(fit_noT, coef = time_cols_noT, number = Inf, sort.by = "F")

## 

```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(splines)

plot_all_vs_ref_noT_sig <- function(t_ref = 7,
                                   fit_noT,
                                   res_time_pairs_noT,
                                   K,
                                   df_spline = 3,
                                   t_min = 0, t_max = 5, n_grid = 200,
                                   ncol = 3,
                                   alpha = 0.05) {

  # ---- 0) build per-pair BH q-values table from topTable output ----
  # topTable has rownames = pair names (same as Y_lr rownames), and adj.P.Val = BH by default
  pair_stats <- data.frame(
    pair_name = rownames(res_time_pairs_noT),
    q = res_time_pairs_noT$adj.P.Val,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(sig = q < alpha)

  # ---- 1) prediction grid ----
  tgrid <- seq(t_min, t_max, length.out = n_grid)
  newdat <- data.frame(time_num = tgrid)

  Xnew <- model.matrix(~ ns(time_num, df = df_spline), data = newdat)
  colnames(Xnew) <- make.names(colnames(Xnew))

  common_cols <- intersect(colnames(Xnew), colnames(fit_noT$coefficients))
  Xnew2 <- Xnew[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
  B2    <- fit_noT$coefficients[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
  rn <- rownames(B2)

  others <- setdiff(seq_len(K), t_ref)

  pred_list <- lapply(others, function(j) {
    pair1 <- paste0("T", j, "_vs_T", t_ref)
    pair2 <- paste0("T", t_ref, "_vs_T", j)

    if (pair1 %in% rn) {
      pair_name <- pair1; sign_mult <- 1
    } else if (pair2 %in% rn) {
      pair_name <- pair2; sign_mult <- -1
    } else return(NULL)

    pred <- as.numeric(B2[pair_name, , drop = TRUE] %*% t(Xnew2))
    pred <- sign_mult * pred

    data.frame(
      time_num = tgrid,
      log_ratio = pred,
      pair_name = pair_name,                 # <-- keep canonical rowname
      pair = paste0("T", j, " vs T", t_ref)   # pretty label
    )
  })

  plot_df <- bind_rows(pred_list) %>%
    left_join(pair_stats, by = "pair_name") %>%
    mutate(
      # add star + BH to facet label
      pair_lab = ifelse(
        sig,
        paste0(pair, "  ★  (BH=", signif(q, 2), ")"),
        paste0(pair, "  (BH=", signif(q, 2), ")")
      )
    )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time_num, y = log_ratio)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(aes(alpha = sig), linewidth = 1.0) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.25), guide = "none") +
    facet_wrap(~ pair_lab, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Shared spline (no tissue): log(Tj/T", t_ref, ").  ★ = BH<", alpha),
      x = "Time (days)",
      y = bquote(log(theta[j]/theta[.(t_ref)]))
    )

  list(p = p, data = plot_df, pair_stats = pair_stats)
}

# Example
out_all_sig <- plot_all_vs_ref_noT_sig(
  t_ref = 7,
  fit_noT = fit_noT,
  res_time_pairs_noT = res_time_pairs_noT,
  K = K,
  df_spline = df_spline,
  ncol = 3,
  alpha = 0.05
)

out_all_sig$p
```

```{r}
out_all_sig <- plot_all_vs_ref_noT_sig(
  t_ref = 1,
  fit_noT = fit_noT,
  res_time_pairs_noT = res_time_pairs_noT,
  K = K,
  df_spline = df_spline,
  ncol = 3,
  alpha = 0.05
)

out_all_sig$p
```
